description: Springtale desktop minimum capability — only the Tauri built-in IPC surfaces the frontend actually invokes. The 125 custom commands registered via `invoke_handler` in lib.rs are NOT gated by capability — Tauri auto-allows registered custom commands. The Rust functions themselves enforce app-level auth (vault unlock, capability bridge, sentinel). See docs/security/RISK-REGISTER.md R-012 / R-013.
